title: Synthetic multi-tool orchestration canary and contract auditor
creator: Lena Park
description: Create a deterministic synthetic canary that exercises multi-tool orchestration across streaming endpoints and SDK adapters, and a contract auditor that validates behavioral invariants. The goal is to detect regressions introduced by runtime changes (kernel selection, batching heuristics, backpressure handling) and API surface shifts (partial-chunk framing, function-call ordering, structured output reconciliation). This ticket covers harness design, golden-oracle capture, CI integration, and an initial rollout to the weekly canary pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Canary harness can generate repeatable multi-tool scenarios (>= 30 seeded permutations) and produce deterministic event traces on the current baseline

Contract auditor asserts a set of invariants: event ordering for toolcall sequences, JSON schema completeness for structured outputs, idempotency on retried tool calls, and KV-cache priming visibility
CI job 'ci-orchestrator-contract-auditor' runs on PRs and nightly, fails on contract violations with actionable failure outputs (golden diff and reconstructed trace)
Documentation page that describes failure modes and remediation steps is published and linked from the CI failure output
Initial rollout executed against hosted and dedicated runners; smoke run against private deployment (staged customer) completes without blocking issues
plan: Design synthetic scenario language that expresses: prompt seed, interleaved user/system messages, tool invocation points, backpressure/partial-chunk injection, and expected structured schemas
Implement harness runner that can replay seeds deterministically across model variants and runtime modes (hosted, dedicated, private) using SDK adapters
Capture golden traces for baseline models and store them in an immutable artifact bucket with metadata (seed, runtime-config, kernel-profile)
Build contract auditor that consumes traces and runs a set of checkers producing machine-readable diffs and human-friendly summaries
Wire auditor into CI: PR-level fast smoke (3 seeds) + nightly full run (30 seeds) + weekly canary against dedicated capacity
Iterate on failure-mode UX: improve diffs, attach reconstructed request/response pairs, and add suggested fix hints
test_matrix: Model variants: redwood-1-small, redwood-1-medium, redwood-1-large, community-v2-quant
Failure injections: truncated-chunk, reordered-chunk, repeated-tool-call, delayed-kvcache-priming
